hypothesis: Contracts whose every outcome-defining rule dimension is certified equal may exhibit executable cross-venue convergence after all four taker fees; incomplete contracts are an unknown review queue, not evidence of either equality or difference.

eligibility.certified_different: automatic hard veto regardless of text score
eligibility.unknown: retain in the rule-review/collection queue but prohibit exact-rule paper entry
eligibility.certified_equal: all dimensions complete and equal; content-addressed exact rule key required
eligibility.books: synchronized A/B-grade executable L2 with no stale leg
eligibility.kalshi_fee_metadata: supported per-market fee schedule required and persisted

exit_rule.timeout: first executable two-venue bid VWAP at or immediately after one hour
exit_rule.terminal_fallback: only for independently hash-certified identical settlement rules

independent_unit: first eligible entry per match_id, direction and UTC day
provisional: The 1% target was inspected in an earlier contaminated grid and remains provisional.
No v6 or earlier observation may be pooled with this trial.
Unknown rule fields may improve discovery coverage but cannot be counted as trades or terminal identities.
